concerns: The updateDeliverable endpoint in DeliverableController uses a plain read-then-save pattern (deliverableRepository.saveAndFlush). Although this is not a blocker because the entity is not reachable from multiple places (no scheduled jobs/independent call sites shown), using the Repository's updateStatusAtomically method would be safer for future-proofing status transitions.
Consider using an Enum for deliverable status to avoid string-based hardcoding in both the model and the repository query UPPER(d.status).

File I/O operations inside getReadinessMetrics are executed on every single request. Lack of caching on file reads could lead to performance bottlenecks if `.eneik/records` grows large or is accessed under high concurrency.

The parsing of files in `.eneik/records` is very basic and text-search-based (contains "verdict": "approve"), which can be fragile if JSON formatting changes slightly (e.g. whitespace, newlines, capitalization) or if nested sub-objects contain similar strings.
